system.description:
You raise a blazing curtain of star chakra between two points you can see within range, as you manifest a wall of energy that overwhelms everything that comes near.

You summon a wall of Star Chakra, up to 60 feet long, 10 feet tall, and 1 foot thick that can be placed along any flat surface within range. Both sides of this wall radiates sickness within 10 feet of it to all creatures, except its caster. Every 10-foot segment of the wall has an AC equal to your Ninjutsu save DC, 40 Hit points, and immunity to Force, Chakra, Poison and Psychic damage when it falls to 0 hit points that segment is destroyed.

Any creature other than you that begins their turn within 10 feet of this wall, or attempts to pass through must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 6d6 force damage and 2 ranks of Star Sickness. On a success they take half damage and no further effects.

Irradiated: The wall has its own gravitational pull. Any creature that is within 10 feet of the wall, and attempts to move further away must make a Strength saving throw, having their movement speed reduced to 0, on a failure, until the end of the current turn.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above B-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 (or 2 star chakra) and the hit points of the wall by +15.
